fact: ITIDA's Root CA has operated since 2009; four licensed providers plus the Ministry of Finance government CA issue certificates, with over 130,000 certificates issued in 2022 and over 375 million e-signature transactions by end 2022, used in e-invoicing, customs pre-registration, e-litigation and justice systems.
title: وزارة الاتصالات وتكنولوجيا المعلومات - التوقيع الإلكتروني
